synergies.links.ssanggeom.name: Twin Swords United
synergies.links.ssanggeom.desc: Swing the Three Powers Sword while the Azure Sky Sword Qi orbits and the two sword qi overlap: that stroke deals 60% more damage and turns gold.
synergies.links.ssanggeom.lore: Namgung and Mount Hua quarreled for a hundred years. Two swordsmen who first stood back to back in the Blood Calamity left this technique.
synergies.links.geomhwa.name: Sword Blossom
synergies.links.geomhwa.desc: Three plum petals bloom where the Three Powers Sword cuts and scatter like Falling Petal Sword Rain shots.
synergies.links.geomhwa.lore: Even the basic sword blooms. It is the first thing a new Mount Hua disciple hears.
synergies.links.gwonjang.name: Fist and Palm as One
synergies.links.gwonjang.desc: The last punch of an Arhat Fist combo fires a short Palm Wind. 50% of Palm Wind damage, piercing.
synergies.links.gwonjang.lore: Close the hand and it is a fist; open it and it is a palm. Shaolin and the Beggars' Sect teach the same words differently.
synergies.links.geumganghu.name: Vajra Roar
synergies.links.geumganghu.desc: When the Sonic Art rings while you strike with the Arhat Fist, the sound wave radius grows 40% and the stun chance doubles.
synergies.links.geumganghu.lore: Arhat Hall trainees shout as they punch.
synergies.links.dokbi.name: Venom Daggers
synergies.links.dokbi.desc: Flying daggers that pass through Poison Mist carry the poison, poisoning the enemies they hit and gaining +1 pierce.
synergies.links.dokbi.lore: The Dang Clan always passes a dagger through the mist once before throwing it.
synergies.links.amgi.name: Hidden Weapon Chain
synergies.links.amgi.desc: When the Flash Finger lands a critical hit, a flying dagger follows to that enemy.
synergies.links.amgi.lore: Where the finger points, the blade goes.
synergies.links.inroe.name: Lightning-Drawing Sword
synergies.links.inroe.desc: Lightning that strikes while the Azure Sky Sword Qi orbits rides the sword ring once around, shocking the enemies inside it.
synergies.links.inroe.lore: It began with a single talisman a Kunlun Taoist lent to a Namgung swordsman.
synergies.links.punghwa.name: Wind and Fire
synergies.links.punghwa.desc: Palm Wind that passes a burning enemy carries the flame, grows 30% larger and burns the enemies it hits.
synergies.links.punghwa.lore: Wind feeds fire. The beggars learned it in front of campfires on winter nights.
synergies.links.jeomhyeol.name: Pressure Point Spear
synergies.links.jeomhyeol.desc: Enemies hit by the Flash Finger have a pressure point sealed and freeze for 0.5 seconds; a Pear Blossom Spear thrust into them always crits.
synergies.links.jeomhyeol.lore: Seal the point first, thrust after. It is the order the Waterway Fort bandits use on deck.
synergies.links.noehwa.name: Thunder and Fire
synergies.links.noehwa.desc: When lightning falls near where a Thunderclap Bomb burst, the explosion goes off once more at double the area.
synergies.links.noehwa.lore: When thunder meets gunpowder, mountains wail.
synergies.links.hyeoldok.name: Blood Venom
synergies.links.hyeoldok.desc: Claw a poisoned enemy with the Blood Claw and the poison spreads through the blood to enemies within 2m.
synergies.links.hyeoldok.lore: This is said to be the first page of the blood venom recipe the Blood Shadow Society handed to the Dang Clan.
synergies.links.geommyeong.name: Singing Sword
synergies.links.geommyeong.desc: When an orbiting Taiji Sword meets a sound wave, the sword sings and sends out one more small sound wave on the spot.
synergies.links.charyeok.name: Borrowed Force
synergies.links.charyeok.desc: An enemy pulled in by the Chain Sickle that touches a Taiji Sword is flung back the other way with the same force and crashes into the enemies behind it.
synergies.links.charyeok.lore: Borrow another's strength to strike another. The first and last principle Wudang teaches.
synergies.links.chwijung.name: Drunken Plum Blossoms
synergies.links.chwijung.desc: The Drunken Immortal Staff gathers drifting petals into a petal whirlwind that circles you for 2 seconds.
synergies.links.chwijung.lore: They say a beggar once swung a staff drunk in the plum grove of Mount Hua.
synergies.links.gyeonin.name: Pull and Strike
synergies.links.gyeonin.desc: The Drunken Immortal Staff bats away enemies dragged in by the chain. If a flung enemy hits another enemy, both take damage.
synergies.links.gyeonin.lore: The work is easy when one side pulls and the other strikes.
synergies.links.hyeolchang.name: Blood Spear
synergies.links.hyeolchang.desc: Enemies run through by the Pear Blossom Spear bleed for 3 seconds; clawing a bleeding enemy with the Blood Claw triples lifesteal.
synergies.links.hyeolchang.lore: The Blood Wolf Troop opens the wound with spears and reaps with claws.
synergies.schools.shaolin.name: Shaolin
synergies.schools.shaolin.tiers.2.desc: The first time Vitality drops below 50%, eighteen Arhat phantoms surround you for 5 seconds and push away enemies they touch (three times per run)
synergies.schools.wudang.name: Wudang
synergies.schools.wudang.tiers.0.desc: The Taiji zone widens from ±25 to ±35
synergies.schools.wudang.tiers.1.desc: Four Ounces Move a Thousand Pounds: while in the Taiji zone, damage taken -20%, and ten times the damage prevented is returned to enemies that touch you
synergies.schools.huashan.name: Mount Hua
synergies.schools.huashan.tiers.1.desc: Every critical hit throws three plum petals that cut nearby enemies
synergies.schools.gaebang.name: Beggars' Sect
synergies.schools.gaebang.tiers.2.desc: Every 3 minutes, three Beggars' Sect disciples appear and fight beside you for 10 seconds
synergies.schools.tang.name: Sichuan Dang Clan
synergies.schools.tang.tiers.1.desc: When a poisoned enemy falls, the poison spreads 2m around it
synergies.schools.tang.tiers.2.desc: Every 20 seconds, a poison needle strikes every enemy on screen
synergies.schools.namgung.name: Namgung Clan
synergies.schools.namgung.tiers.1.desc: Every third sword technique attack, a sword qi plunges from the sky
synergies.schools.waterfort.name: Yangtze Waterway Fort
synergies.schools.waterfort.tiers.1.desc: Lightfoot distance +50%; enemies you pass through are dragged along
synergies.schools.waterfort.tiers.2.desc: Elite Treasure Chests give one more technique upgrade
synergies.schools.kunlun.name: Kunlun
synergies.schools.kunlun.tiers.0.desc: Enemies frozen by a Stilling Talisman stay frozen twice as long
synergies.schools.demonic.name: Demonic Path
synergies.schools.demonic.tiers.0.desc: Lifesteal x2, but food healing is halved. The Blood Demon's Whisper appears more often
synergies.common.name: Mastery of the Basics
synergies.common.desc: With the Three Powers Sword at Lv8, your most-gathered sect gains one more Lineage step. All martial learning branches out from the basics.
synergies.secrets.nakmae_geomseon.name: Blood of the Fallen Plum Sword Immortal
synergies.secrets.nakmae_geomseon.condit: Be born a Mount Hua disciple, have Falling Petal Sword Rain Lv8 and Plum Blossom Method Lv5, and have cleared Chapter 5 (Mount Hua) before
synergies.secrets.nakmae_geomseon.reward: Falling Petal Sword Rain becomes the secret art 'Falling Plum, One Sword' (落梅一劍), and the One Sword ultimate breaks three times like a plum branch
synergies.secrets.nakmae_geomseon.hint.0: One who shared the name buried a sword on the cliff
synergies.secrets.nakmae_geomseon.hint.1: When the plum blooms again, that sword will weep
synergies.secrets.eogang.name: Corpse Taming
synergies.secrets.eogang.condition: Holding the Thunder Talisman, Chain Sickle and Taoist Gate Method, use three or more Stilling Talismans in one run
synergies.secrets.eogang.reward: Drag a jiangshi frozen by a Stilling Talisman in with the chain to re-stick the talisman on its forehead and command it for 30 seconds (up to ten)
synergies.secrets.eogang.hint.0: A talisman does more than make them stop
synergies.secrets.eogang.hint.1: Whose side is the one bound at the chain's end on?
synergies.secrets.maehwa_samnong.name: Plum Blossom Three Variations
synergies.secrets.maehwa_samnong.conditi: Have the Sonic Art, Falling Petal Sword Rain and Plum Blossom Method all at Lv5 or higher
synergies.secrets.maehwa_samnong.reward: Every third sound wave raises a plum blossom storm that fills the screen
synergies.secrets.maehwa_samnong.hint.0: When the zither sounds three times
synergies.secrets.mugeuk.name: Wuji
synergies.secrets.mugeuk.condition: Holding Taiji Sword Lv8 and Two Forms Method Lv5, keep the Yin-Yang gauge at 0 without moving a single notch for 3 minutes
synergies.secrets.mugeuk.reward: The Yin-Yang gauge disappears and every technique gets both the Yin and Yang bonus (+40%)
synergies.secrets.chwiseon.name: Drunken Immortal
synergies.secrets.chwiseon.condition: With the Drunken Immortal Staff and Wine Immortal Art, eat fifteen foods in one run and open a Treasure Chest at or below 20% Vitality
synergies.secrets.chwiseon.reward: Each food you eat stacks Might +3%, and your staggering steps let attacks slide off 20% of the time
synergies.secrets.yeokcheon.name: Defying Heaven
synergies.secrets.yeokcheon.condition: At an extreme (±70), break Backlash with Lightfoot within 1 second three times in a row
synergies.secrets.yeokcheon.reward: Backlash never returns for the rest of the run, and the extreme bonus stays
synergies.secrets.hyeolhae_janpyeon.name: Fragment of the Blood Sea Demon Art
synergies.secrets.hyeolhae_janpyeon.cond: Holding the Blood Claw and Blood Sea Method, with three or more Medical Books gathered, break a Silver Lantern
synergies.secrets.hyeolhae_janpyeon.rewa: The Blood Demon's Whisper is certain to appear that run. Accept it to gain the Blood Art, and the story leans toward the Inheritance ending
synergies.secrets.hyeolhae_janpyeon.hint: is tucked a page written in blood
synergies.secrets.mumyeong.name: Nameless Sword
synergies.secrets.mumyeong.condition: With no other attack technique, pass 10 minutes of game time with only the Three Powers Sword at Lv8
synergies.secrets.mumyeong.reward: Three Powers Sword damage +50%, Ultimate Art charge x2. Kept even if you learn new techniques later
synergies.secrets.mumyeong.hint.0: The one who swung the simplest sword
synergies.encounters.cliff.name: Cliff Encounter
synergies.encounters.cliff.where: The cliff at the map's edge in walled chapters (Prologue, Chapters 3, 4, 5)
synergies.encounters.cliff.how: Leap off the cliff with Lightfoot. Once per run
synergies.encounters.cliff.reward: A manual on the cave wall below: one of your techniques gains +2 levels, or learn one locked technique for this run
synergies.encounters.hermit.name: Hidden Master
synergies.encounters.hermit.where: An old man playing go in a corner of the map, in any chapter
synergies.encounters.hermit.how: Stay beside him for 6 seconds. Enemies keep coming all the while
synergies.encounters.hermit.reward: Choose one more breakthrough Insight. Opens a conversation with Elder Mok at the inn
synergies.encounters.relic.name: Remains of a Master
synergies.encounters.relic.where: A fallen master of that land's sect (a Shaolin monk in Chapter 1, a Dang Clan warrior in Chapter 2 …)
synergies.encounters.relic.how: Approach and stand still for 1 second to pay respects
synergies.encounters.relic.reward: Counts as one more Lineage step of that sect for this run
synergies.encounters.elixir.name: Elixir
synergies.encounters.elixir.where: A glowing vine or a crack in the rock (thousand-year fleeceflower root, stalactite milk)
synergies.encounters.elixir.reward: Ultimate Art gauge full, Yin-Yang gauge 0
synergies.encounters.spiritbeast.name: Spirit Beast
synergies.encounters.spiritbeast.where: Each chapter's spirit beast (white crane in Chapter 4, snow ginseng child in Chapter 6)
synergies.encounters.spiritbeast.how: Chase it down and catch it as it runs, like the Golden Toad
synergies.encounters.letter.name: Lower Five Gates Letter
synergies.encounters.letter.where: A note Unnang hid inside a lantern
synergies.encounters.letter.reward: One more line of the condition for an undiscovered Secret Legacy is revealed
synergies.encounters.whisper.name: The Blood Demon's Whisper
synergies.encounters.whisper.where: A red stone statue that appears after 15 minutes of game time
synergies.encounters.whisper.how: Use your Ultimate Art before the statue to accept; walk past to refuse
synergies.encounters.whisper.reward: Accept to gain the Blood Art and one Demonic Path Lineage step. The price: healing halved and the mark of the Inheritance ending
synergies.encounters.sword_tomb.name: Sword Tomb
synergies.encounters.sword_tomb.where: The sword grave atop the cliffs of Mount Hua in Chapter 5
synergies.encounters.sword_tomb.how: Plant one sword (discard one attack technique for this run)
synergies.encounters.sword_tomb.reward: Might +3% to your remaining techniques for each level of the discarded technique
